card: Fixes out-of-bounds reads in UniValue's JSON tokenizer by respecting the buffer end pointer during keyword matching and number validation. Previously, parsing non-null-terminated string views could read past the buffer end when encountering truncated keywords or bare minus/zero prefixes. This resolves issue #28260 and updates UniValue unit and fuzz tests to exercise bounded string views.
changed_since_previous: Removed trailing whitespace trimming from the UniValue unit tester by stripping newlines from round-trip JSON test files.
evidence: Fixes #28260 ('getJsonToken assumes underlying string is null-terminated but requires end pointer')
PR description: 'Avoid reading past the supplied end pointer in two places: matching JSON keywords with strncmp; validating number prefixes with firstDigit[1].'
problem: UniValue's `getJsonToken` accepts explicit `raw` and `end` pointers to parse bounded string views without requiring null termination. In two places—matching `null`, `true`, and `false` via `strncmp`, and checking `firstDigit[1]` to reject leading zeros—the parser inspected bytes past `end` if the input terminated prematurely, causing out-of-bounds reads.

risk.why: A flaw in JSON tokenization could incorrectly reject valid JSON or crash the node during RPC and REST request handling.

scope_notes: Modifies internal UniValue parsing code, strips trailing newlines from UniValue test JSON files to eliminate rtrim logic, and changes the parse_univalue fuzz target from std::string to std::string_view.
summary: Enforces buffer end boundaries in UniValue's JSON tokenizer when matching keyword literals and inspecting number prefixes. Replaces `strncmp` keyword checks with `std::string_view::starts_with` and adds bounds checks before indexing into adjacent digit characters. Also updates the UniValue unit tests, roundtrip test data, and fuzz harness to exercise non-null-terminated string views.
